Banner.name: id
Banner.description: Unique identifier passed to the root element

Banner.name: title
Banner.description: Heading text rendered in the banner overlay

Banner.name: subtitle
Banner.description: Sub-heading text displayed below the title

Banner.name: ctaText
Banner.description: Call-to-action button label; renders an anchor when set

Banner.name: mapLinks
Banner.description: Link objects; first entry used as the CTA href

Banner.name: textAlignment
Banner.description: Text alignment for all banner content

Banner.name: className
Banner.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

Banner.name: hotspots
Banner.description: Clickable image-map regions (rect/oval/polygon) overlaid on the media, each linking to a URL or deeplink

Banner.name: lazyLoad
Banner.description: Defer mounting media/hotspots until the banner scrolls near the viewport (default: true)

AnnouncementBar.name: mapLinks
AnnouncementBar.description: When provided, wraps message in an anchor using first entry's URL

AnnouncementBar.name: backgroundColor
AnnouncementBar.description: CSS colour for the bar background (default: #8b5cf6)

AnnouncementBar.name: textColor
AnnouncementBar.description: CSS colour for the message text (default: #ffffff)

AnnouncementBar.name: className
AnnouncementBar.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

GridBanner.name: items
GridBanner.description: Array of card items to display in the grid

GridBanner.name: columns
GridBanner.description: Number of grid columns on desktop (default: 3); collapses to 2 at 768 px, 1 at 480 px

GridBanner.name: className
GridBanner.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

GridBanner.name: isLoading
GridBanner.description: Applies shimmer skeleton animation to all cards

GridBanner.name: lazyLoad
GridBanner.description: Defer mounting card media until the grid scrolls near the viewport (default: true)

MediaGrid.name: primaryMedia
MediaGrid.description: The large featured asset occupying 2/3 of the grid width

MediaGrid.name: secondaryMedia
MediaGrid.description: Optional stacked secondary assets in the right column

MediaGrid.name: className
MediaGrid.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

MediaGrid.name: isLoading
MediaGrid.description: Applies shimmer skeleton loading animation to the grid

MediaGrid.name: lazyLoad
MediaGrid.description: Defer mounting media until the grid scrolls near the viewport (default: true)

RowScrollable.name: items
RowScrollable.description: Array of card items to render in the scrollable row

RowScrollable.name: title
RowScrollable.description: Optional section heading displayed above the row

RowScrollable.name: className
RowScrollable.description: Additional CSS class names on the root container

RowScrollable.name: config.hideArrowsIfNoScroll
RowScrollable.description: Hide navigation arrows if content doesn't overflow container width

RowScrollable.name: config.hideScrollbar
RowScrollable.description: Hide the browser scrollbar while keeping swipe/scroll functionality

RowScrollable.name: isLoading
RowScrollable.description: Applies shimmer skeleton loading animation to all items

RowScrollable.name: lazyLoad
RowScrollable.description: Defer mounting card media until the row scrolls near the viewport (default: true)

SlidingBanner.name: config.autoStart
SlidingBanner.description: Whether to auto-play the slides (default: true)

SlidingBanner.name: config.rotateAgain
SlidingBanner.description: Whether to loop back to the first slide (default: true)

SlidingBanner.name: config.hideArrowsIfNoScroll
SlidingBanner.description: Hide arrows if there is only one slide (default: true)

SlidingBanner.name: className
SlidingBanner.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

SlidingBanner.name: isLoading
SlidingBanner.description: Applies shimmer to all slide backgrounds

SlidingBanner.name: lazyLoad
SlidingBanner.description: Defer autoplay/canvas effects and slide media until scrolled near the viewport (default: true)

AlternatingSlider.name: items
AlternatingSlider.description: Flat list; grouped into slide-sets by the columns config value

AlternatingSlider.name: config.autoStart
AlternatingSlider.description: Whether to auto-play the slider (default: true)

AlternatingSlider.name: config.hideArrowsIfNoScroll
AlternatingSlider.description: Hide arrows if there is only one slide set (default: true)

AlternatingSlider.name: className
AlternatingSlider.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

AlternatingSlider.name: isLoading
AlternatingSlider.description: Applies shimmer animation to all cells

AlternatingSlider.name: lazyLoad
AlternatingSlider.description: Defer autoplay and slide media until scrolled near the viewport (default: true)

TimerWidget.name: targetDate
TimerWidget.description: ISO 8601 date-time string; the countdown ticks towards this date

TimerWidget.name: title
TimerWidget.description: Optional heading displayed above the timer blocks

TimerWidget.name: className
TimerWidget.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

TimerWidget.name: lazyLoad
TimerWidget.description: Defer starting the countdown interval until scrolled near the viewport (default: true)

WysiwygRenderer.name: htmlContent
WysiwygRenderer.description: Raw HTML string from a CMS rich-text field; rendered with innerHTML

WysiwygRenderer.name: className
WysiwygRenderer.description: Additional CSS class names on the wrapper element

WysiwygRenderer.name: widgetData
WysiwygRenderer.description: Optional data object for embedded widgets

WysiwygRenderer.name: lazyLoad
WysiwygRenderer.description: Defer rendering HTML and processing social/widget embeds until scrolled near the viewport (default: true)

RichTextEditor.name: content
RichTextEditor.description: Initial HTML content for the editor.

RichTextEditor.name: initialContent
RichTextEditor.description: Initial HTML content for the editor if content is not controlled.

RichTextEditor.name: onMediaRequest
RichTextEditor.description: Callback to open an external media library modal.

RichTextEditor.name: availableClasses
RichTextEditor.description: Array of custom class names available for the user to apply.

RichTextEditor.name: className
RichTextEditor.description: Additional CSS class names for the wrapper element.

RichTextEditor.name: config.toolbar
RichTextEditor.description: List of toolbar buttons to display (e.g. ['bold', 'italic', 'underline', 'link']).
